Name: Tel-abib
ModernLocation: Near Nippur, Iraq, by the Chebar
Description: Tel-abib was a settlement of the exiles by the river Chebar, where Ezekiel lived among the captives and where the hand of the LORD came upon him.
BiblicalSignificance: Tel-abib is the exile's address: the place by the Chebar where a prophet sat among the captives for seven days, astonished, before he spoke.
